toolsPreview.name: search_protocols
toolsPreview.description: Search the AdvertisingProtocols catalog of 80+ ad tech standards (OpenRTB, VAST, AdCP, AAMP, UID2, ARTF, etc.) by keyword. Matches title, description, tags, and category.

toolsPreview.name: get_protocol
toolsPreview.description: Fetch details for one advertising protocol by its slug (e.g. 'openrtb-2', 'adcp', 'aamp', 'ucp'). Returns description, governance, evidence links, use cases, and dependencies.

toolsPreview.name: list_mcp_servers
toolsPreview.description: List MCP servers in the AdvertisingProtocols directory. Optionally filter by protocol slug/label (e.g. 'adcp'), vendor, category, or 'officialOnly' to get only publisher-owned servers.

toolsPreview.name: search_glossary
toolsPreview.description: Search the AdvertisingProtocols glossary of 130+ ad tech terms (DSP, SSP, RTB, TCF, etc.) and return plain-English definitions.
